decisions.decision: Replace test-written temp fixture with committed observations file.
decisions.rationale: Two test binaries wrote the same temp path concurrently causing a race; a committed file cannot race and a reader can open it.
decisions.quote: The repair is that the observations are a committed file rather than one a test invents:

decisions.decision: Create observations as four synthetic instants with known shifts.
decisions.rationale: So residuals are known in advance and can be checked by eye; three inside window and +41 outside demonstrates width property.
decisions.quote: four synthetic instants that are the predicted centres of four cycles moved by 0, +3, -7 and +41 seconds, so the residuals are known in advance and can be checked by eye.

decisions.decision: Add residuals command as worked example in manual.
decisions.rationale: Fixture is a demonstrable example and generated into manual alongside rest.
decisions.quote: 37 worked examples now, because the fixture is a demonstrable example and is generated into the manual alongside the rest.

decisions.decision: Add release note documenting flaky test and repair.
decisions.rationale: Record that CI found flaky test and how it was fixed.
decisions.quote: **CI found a flaky test the cut commit shipped, and I had not.**

decisions.decision: Keep 'no observations read' as error rather than agreement.
decisions.rationale: Comparing nothing should not be a report of agreement.
decisions.quote: correctly, because "no observations were read" is an error rather than a report of agreement having compared nothing.

decisions.decision: Do not fit or extract quadratic trend (Ṗ) from residuals.
decisions.rationale: Least squares fitting needs to know which code produced the number, so it is not produced.

alternatives.alternative: Write temp fixture into std::env::temp_dir() under fixed name.
alternatives.reason: Race condition: one test truncated the file while the other read it.
alternatives.quote: Two test binaries wrote the residuals fixture into std::env::temp_dir() under the same fixed name, and they run concurrently.

alternatives.alternative: Have the test invent observations without known shifts.
alternatives.reason: Residuals would not be known in advance, so cannot be checked by eye.
alternatives.quote: rather than one a test invents: four synthetic instants that are the predicted centres of four cycles moved by 0, +3, -7 and +41 seconds, so the residuals are known in advance and can be checked by eye.

alternatives.alternative: Not include residuals command in the manual as a worked example.
alternatives.reason: The fixture is a demonstrable example and should be generated into the manual.
alternatives.quote: 37 worked examples now, because the fixture is a demonstrable example and is generated into the manual alongside the rest.

alternatives.alternative: Do not add a release note documenting the flaky test.
alternatives.reason: Record that CI found flaky test and how it was fixed.
alternatives.quote: **CI found a flaky test the cut commit shipped, and I had not.**

alternatives.alternative: Treat no observations read as agreement (compare nothing).
alternatives.reason: Comparing nothing should not be a report of agreement.
alternatives.quote: "no observations were read" is an error rather than a report of agreement having compared nothing.

alternatives.alternative: Fit or extract quadratic trend (Ṗ) from residuals.
alternatives.reason: Least squares fitting needs to know which code produced the number, so it is not produced.
alternatives.quote: **This reports and does not fit.** A quadratic trend in these residuals is `Ṗ`, and extracting it is least squares — which is where a reader most needs to know which code produced the number, so it is not produced here.

consequences.text: Committed fixture cannot race and a reader can open it.
consequences.quote: A fixture a reader can open is better than one a test writes, and it cannot race with anything.

consequences.text: Residuals are known in advance and can be checked by eye.
consequences.quote: so the residuals are known in advance and can be checked by eye.

consequences.text: Three residuals inside own windows, +41 outside, demonstrating width property.
